description: Check a business's published menu against what a country's menu rules ask for — allergen and calorie declarations, price-list notices, banned surcharges, operator identity. Returns each requirement with its official sources, plus which ones the menu currently falls short of and the item ids involved. ADVISORY ONLY: it reports, it never changes the site, and it is not legal advice.

country.description: ISO country to check against. Defaults to the business's own country_code; pass one explicitly to check against a market the business is considering.

name: check_compliance
